# Veyra Trading

> Private Discord membership (Alpha Membership, $200/month, cancel anytime) where Veyra, a futures trader with more than 7 years of experience, calls NQ futures signals live during a stream, Monday to Friday from the 9:30 a.m. New York open. Futures trading involves substantial risk of loss; signals and live sessions do not guarantee results.
